records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个框架，用于评估错误指定的决策者是否愿意为可能减少错误指定的信息付费。我们引入了一种基于“约束”最大后悔的无先验方法，以得出对通过获取更准确的模型获得的潜在收益进行主观评估的上限。约束源于决策者当前可用的信息。我们将我们的方法应用于三错误指定信念的突出模型：粗略预期、因果误解和抽样均衡。

records.title_en: Data Linkages and Privacy Regulation
records.title_cn: 数据链接和隐私监管
records.abstract_en: We assess the efficacy of privacy regulation when consumers are privacy conscious. We develop a model of data linkages where a consumer interacts sequentially with two firms: One firm collects data on consumer behavior, and the other firm leverages the data to set a quality level and a price. A data linkage benefits the consumer in equilibrium when the recipient firm is sufficiently similar to the collecting firm. We endogenize linkage formation under several existing privacy regulations. Voluntary consent requirements benefit consumers in equilibrium, but blanket bans on discriminatory price and quality offers harm them.
records.abstract_cn: 当消费者具有隐私意识时，我们评估隐私监管的有效性。我们开发了一个数据链接模型，其中消费者按顺序与二公司进行交互：一公司收集消费者行为数据，另一家公司利用这些数据来设定质量水平和价格。当接收公司与收集公司足够相似时，数据链接对均衡的消费者有利。我们根据几项现有的隐私法规内生了联系的形成。自愿同意要求在均衡状态下有利于消费者，但全面禁止歧视性价格和质量优惠会损害消费者的利益。

records.title_en: The Economics of Discriminatory Job Reservations
records.title_cn: 歧视性职位保留的经济学
records.abstract_en: A society reserves certain jobs for members of a politically dominant social group to maximize the wages of workers in that group. Through an appropriate choice of reserved jobs, the dominant group chooses both the size of the set of reserved jobs and the elasticity of substitution between reserved and unreserved jobs. Optimal discrimination endogenously creates categories of "good" and "bad" jobs and assigns workers from different social groups into these different categories. The relative scarcity of labor determines whether discrimination or free labor markets are optimal. I apply the model to apartheid South Africa and other discriminatory societies.
records.abstract_cn: 一个社会为政治上占主导地位的社会群体的成员保留某些工作，以最大限度地提高该群体工人的工资。通过对保留工作岗位的适当选择，主导群体既选择了保留工作岗位的规模，也选择了保留工作岗位与非保留工作岗位之间的替代弹性。最优歧视内生地创造了“好”和“坏”工作的类别，并将来自不同社会群体的工人分配到这些不同的类别中。劳动力的相对稀缺决定了歧视还是自由劳动力市场是否最优。我将这个模型应用于种族隔离的南非和其他歧视性社会。

records.title_en: Sequential Protest Formation
records.title_cn: 连续抗议队形
records.abstract_en: People participate in protests even though it is costly, benefits are not exclusive to participants, and each individual is unlikely to be pivotal. Building on these characteristics, I propose a sequential model of protest formation where opportunities to participate arrive stochastically, and the protest succeeds if participation surpasses a threshold. I show a unique equilibrium exists and characterize its dynamics. If the unique equilibrium involves participation, the time between participation decisions shortens as the protest progresses—a pattern observed empirically. A player with an opportunity becomes sequentially pivotal if, after abstaining, the protest will likely end before another opportunity arrives.
records.abstract_cn: 人们参与抗议活动，尽管成本高昂，利益也并非参与者独有，而且每个人不太可能发挥关键作用。基于这些特征，我提出了一个抗议形成的序列模型，其中参与的机会是随机到达的，如果参与超过阈值，抗议就会成功。我展示了一种独特的平衡的存在并描述了它的动态。如果独特的均衡涉及参与，那么参与决策之间的时间就会随着抗议的进展而缩短——这是根据经验观察到的模式。如果在弃权后，抗议很可能在另一个机会到来之前结束，那么一个有机会的球员就会变得关键。

records.title_en: Liquidity Constraints and the Value of Insurance
records.title_cn: 流动性限制和保险价值
records.abstract_en: Insurance moves resources across both time and states. We study the consumption-smoothing benefits of insurance under liquidity constraints in a model where contracts span multiple consumption periods. The normative benchmarks for insurance demand under liquidity constraints differ qualitatively and quantitatively from the standard model: Individuals may only partially insure at actuarially fair prices, may benefit from insurance when premiums are very high and even sometimes when dominated, and may value insurance against events that will surely happen. Using simulations for health insurance, we highlight how these findings generate insights about how cost-sharing should be designed differently for liquidity-constrained populations.
records.abstract_cn: 保险可以跨时间和跨州转移资源。我们在合同跨越多个消费期的模型中研究了流动性约束下保险的消费平滑效益。流动性约束下的保险需求规范基准在质量和数量上都与标准模型不同：个人可能仅以精算公平价格部分投保，当保费非常高甚至有时在占主导地位时可能会从保险中受益，并且可能会针对肯定会发生的事件评估保险。通过对健康保险的模拟，我们强调这些发现如何产生关于如何针对流动性受限人群以不同方式设计成本分摊的见解。

records.title_en: Failures of Contingent Reasoning in Annuitization Decisions
records.title_cn: 年金化决策中的或然推理失败
records.abstract_en: This paper studies psychological biases in take-up of annuities, using an incentivized experiment with a probability-based sample (N = 3,038). Choosing an annuity was payoff-maximizing in the experiment at all prices, but take-up was incomplete and price elastic. Reformulating decisions as insurance against a "bad" outcome rather than insurance against "longevity risk" did not increase take-up. Instead, we find substantial failures of contingent reasoning: Participants underappreciated how annuitization mitigated the need for less-efficient means of saving for retirement. Increasing the salience of the interaction with savings decisions, or eliminating the need to think through this interaction altogether, substantially increased annuity take-up.
records.abstract_cn: 本文使用基于概率的样本进行激励实验（N = 3,038），研究了领取年金时的心理偏差。在所有价格的实验中，选择年金都是收益最大化，但采用并不完全且价格有弹性。将决策重新制定为针对“不良”结果的保险，而不是针对“长寿风险”的保险，并没有增加采用率。相反，我们发现条件推理的重大失败：参与者低估了年金化如何减轻对低效退休储蓄方式的需求。提高与储蓄决策的相互作用的显着性，或者消除完全考虑这种相互作用的需要，大大增加了年金的使用。

records.title_en: Product Liability Litigation and Innovation: Evidence from Medical Devices
records.title_cn: 产品责任诉讼与创新：来自医疗器械的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the impact of product liability litigation on new product introductions by leading medical device firms. We find that the defendant firms, and other firms to a lesser extent, reduce their propensity to introduce new products in the litigated product categories during litigation years. We also show that changes to safety regulation influence the likelihood of litigation. Lastly, we show that the potential welfare loss due to litigation appears relatively contained: The decline in new product introductions is not permanent, it does not spill over beyond the litigated categories, and litigation induces firms to develop safer devices.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究产品责任诉讼对领先医疗器械公司新产品推出的影响。我们发现，被告公司和其他公司在诉讼期间减少了在诉讼产品类别中推出新产品的倾向，但程度较轻。我们还表明，安全监管的变化会影响诉讼的可能性。最后，我们表明，诉讼造成的潜在福利损失似乎相对有限：新产品推出的下降不是永久性的，它不会溢出到诉讼类别之外，而且诉讼会促使公司开发更安全的设备。

records.title_en: Emission Caps and Investment in Green Technologies
records.title_cn: 排放上限与绿色技术投资
records.abstract_en: We study the interaction between firms, which can invest in green technologies, and a government, which can impose emission caps but has limited commitment power. Investment in green technologies generates innovation spillovers, reducing the cost of further investments. Spillovers generate intertemporal strategic complementarities between firms and government, and equilibrium multiplicity. In a “green equilibrium”, firms, anticipating caps, invest in green technologies, which reduces the cost of further investment, making the government willing to cap emissions. In a “brown equilibrium”, firms, anticipating no caps, don’t invest, so green technologies remain costly and the government gives up on emission caps.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究可以投资绿色技术的企业与政府之间的互动，其中政府能够设定排放上限，但承诺能力有限。绿色技术投资会产生创新溢出效应，降低进一步投资的成本。溢出效应在企业与政府之间形成跨期战略互补，并导致均衡多重性。在“绿色均衡”中，企业预期政府会设定上限，因而投资绿色技术；这又降低进一步投资的成本，使政府愿意设定排放上限。在“棕色均衡”中，企业预期政府不会设定上限，因而不投资，绿色技术仍然昂贵，政府最终放弃排放上限。

records.title_en: Corporate Green Pledges
records.title_cn: 企业绿色承诺
records.abstract_en: We build a novel data set of time-stamped corporate decarbonization commitments—green pledges—for U.S. public firms by classifying news articles with large language models and human validation. Firms announcing green pledges tend to be larger and browner than other firms, both within and across industries. Green pledges significantly raise stock prices, consistent with a reduction in the carbon premium, and predict sizable declines in future carbon emissions and emission intensities. These effects tend to be strongest for firms in brown industries. Green pledges thus appear credible, convey relevant new information to investors, and provide meaningful financial incentives to decarbonize.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过大型语言模型分类新闻文章并辅以人工验证，为美国上市公司构建了一个带时间戳的企业脱碳承诺——绿色承诺——新数据集。宣布绿色承诺的企业，无论在行业内部还是行业之间，往往规模更大、碳排放更高。绿色承诺显著提高股价，与碳溢价下降相一致，并预示着未来碳排放量和排放强度将大幅下降。这些影响在高排放行业企业中往往最强。因此，绿色承诺似乎可信，能够向投资者传递相关新信息，并为企业脱碳提供有意义的金融激励。

records.title_en: Green Investing and Political Behavior
records.title_cn: 绿色投资与政治行为
records.abstract_en: A fundamental concern about green investing is that it may crowd out political support for public policies addressing negative externalities. We examine this concern in a preregistered experiment conducted shortly before a real referendum on a climate law in Switzerland. We find that offering an opportunity to invest in a climate-friendly fund does not reduce individual support for climate regulation, measured by political donations and voting intentions. A replication of the experiment in the United Kingdom yields similar results. Our estimates reject a crowding-out effect, suggesting instead a modest crowding-in effect of green investing on political support for green policies.
records.abstract_cn: 绿色投资的一个根本担忧是，它可能挤出公众支持应对负外部性的公共政策。我们在瑞士一项气候法真实公投前不久开展预注册实验，检验这一担忧。我们发现，提供投资气候友好型基金的机会，并不会降低个人对气候监管的支持；这种支持通过政治捐款和投票意向来衡量。在英国开展的实验复制也得到类似结果。我们的估计拒绝了挤出效应，反而表明绿色投资对绿色政策的政治支持具有温和的挤入效应。

records.title_en: ESG Shocks in Global Supply Chains
records.title_cn: 全球供应链中的ESG冲击
records.abstract_en: We show that U.S. firms cut imports by 31.8% when their international suppliers experience environmental and social (E&S) incidents. These trade cuts are larger for publicly listed U.S. importers facing high E&S investor pressure and lead to cross-country supplier reallocation, suggesting that E&S preferences in capital markets can be privately costly but have real effects for foreign suppliers. Larger trade cuts around the incident result in better supplier E&S performance in subsequent years and in the eventual resumption of trade. Our results highlight the role of investors in ensuring suppliers’ E&S compliance along global supply chains.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，当国际供应商发生环境和社会（E&S）事件时，美国企业会将进口削减31.8%。面对较高E&S投资者压力的美国上市进口商，其贸易削减幅度更大，并会在国家之间重新配置供应商；这表明，资本市场中的E&S偏好可能给企业带来私人成本，但会对外国供应商产生实际影响。事件发生前后的贸易削减越大，供应商随后几年的E&S表现越好，贸易最终恢复的可能性也越高。我们的结果凸显了投资者在确保全球供应链供应商遵守E&S要求方面的作用。

records.title_en: Smokestacks and the Swamp
records.title_cn: 烟囱与沼泽
records.abstract_en: We examine whether politicians affect local firms’ industrial pollution, and whether such effects are transmitted through plant-level networks to affect pollution in other regions. We first document that close Democrat wins in U.S. congressional races are associated with lower emissions and higher abatement at the plant level, especially when politicians have strong pro-environmental preferences. We also find evidence of reallocation: firms shift emissions away from areas represented by Democrats. However, reallocation is imperfect: firm-level costs are higher and market-to-book ratios lower if firms’ representation is more Democratic. Lower pollution-related illnesses around plants in Democratic districts suggest pass-through effects on local communities.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察政治人物是否会影响当地企业的工业污染，以及这种影响是否会通过工厂层面的网络传播，进而影响其他地区的污染。首先我们发现，美国国会选举中民主党候选人的微弱获胜，与工厂层面更低的排放和更高的减排相关；当政治人物具有强烈的亲环境偏好时，这种关系尤其明显。我们还发现了重新配置的证据：企业会将排放从民主党代表的地区转移出去。然而，重新配置并不完全：如果企业所在地区由更多民主党人代表，企业层面的成本更高，市值账面比更低。民主党选区工厂周围与污染相关的疾病较少，表明污染影响会传导至当地社区。

records.title_en: The Cost of Regulatory Compliance in the United States
records.title_cn: 美国监管合规成本
records.abstract_en: A key question for studying business dynamism is whether the costs of regulatory compliance fall homogeneously on small and large businesses. Using comprehensive establishment-level occupational microdata and occupation task information, we quantify a firm’s compliance costs as the share of wage bill for performing regulatory compliance tasks (RegIndex). We reveal an inverted-U relationship between firms’ RegIndex and their size: On average, RegIndex for mid-sized firms with around 500 employees is about 47% greater than that of the smallest firms and 18% greater than that of the largest firms. We further develop a shift-share methodology to disentangle the influence of regulatory requirements and enforcement on driving firms’ compliance costs.
records.abstract_cn: 研究企业活力的一个关键问题是，监管合规成本是否会同等地落在大企业和小企业身上。利用全面的企业层面职业微观数据和职业任务信息，我们将企业合规成本量化为完成监管合规任务的工资总额占比（RegIndex）。我们发现，企业RegIndex与企业规模之间呈倒U形关系：平均而言，拥有约500名员工的中型企业，其RegIndex比最小企业高47%，比最大企业高18%。我们进一步提出一种转移份额方法，以区分监管要求和执法对企业合规成本的影响。

records.title_en: Heterogeneous Oil Supply Elasticities: Indebtedness and Production Responses to the COVID-19 Shock
records.title_cn: 异质性的石油供给弹性：负债与COVID-19冲击下的生产反应
records.abstract_en: Debt matters for oil supply elasticities. We document the resiliency of oil production to the COVID-19-related collapse in demand due to indebtedness. We use exogenous variation in the timing of debt-related payments to identify financially constrained operators. We show that more financially constrained firms cut production by less than less-constrained firms and were less likely to complete new wells. To explore the mechanisms, we use borrowing-limit cuts and credit-line drawdowns to measure access to credit, and we exploit failed hedging practices. The propagation of oil demand shocks crucially depends on the indebtedness of the oil sector.
records.abstract_cn: 债务会影响石油供给弹性。我们记录了由于负债，石油生产对COVID-19相关需求崩溃表现出的韧性。我们利用债务相关付款时间的外生变化，识别受到财务约束的经营者。我们表明，财务约束更强的企业比约束较弱的企业少削减产量，也较不可能完成新油井。为探究作用机制，我们利用借款限额削减和信用额度支取来衡量信贷可得性，并利用对冲失败的做法。石油需求冲击的传导在关键程度上取决于石油部门的负债状况。
